header: UNVERIFIED — festival rules must be reviewed by a priest. Dates computed from these rules are NOT authoritative.
description: Festival rules. 'month' is the AMANTA lunar month name (new moon to new moon). 'tithi' is the number within the paksha, 1..15 (Shukla 15 = Purnima, Krishna 15 = Amavasya). 'observance' names a window in observance-windows.json. Festivals are matched only in nija (non-adhik) months.

festivals.regionNotes: Amavasya of amanta Ashvin = Amavasya of purnimanta Kartika. Lakshmi Puja is performed during Pradosh while Amavasya prevails.

Amanta Shravana Krishna Ashtami = purnimanta Bhadrapada Krishna Ashtami. Smarta and Vaishnava (ISKCON) observances can differ by a day; Rohini nakshatra is also considered by some traditions. Not modelled.
Traditionally decided by Navami prevailing at Madhyahna (midday). The spec's rule set has no madhyahna rule, so sunrise is used; review.
Amanta Magha Krishna Chaturdashi = purnimanta Phalguna Krishna Chaturdashi. Decided by Chaturdashi prevailing at Nishita kaal.
Phalguna Purnima during Pradosh. Traditional rules also avoid Bhadra (Vishti karana); not modelled. Holi (colours) is the following day.
Ashvin Shukla Pratipada. Ghatasthapana muhurat is usually in the morning while Pratipada prevails.
Ashvin Shukla Dashami during Aparahna. Shravana nakshatra is also considered by some traditions; not modelled.
Amanta Ashvin Krishna Chaturthi = purnimanta Kartika Krishna Chaturthi. Traditionally the Chaturthi should prevail at moonrise; Pradosh is used here as the nearest available rule; review.
Shravana Purnima, preferably during Aparahna and avoiding Bhadra (Vishti karana); Bhadra avoidance not modelled.
Bhadrapada Shukla Chaturthi. Traditionally decided by Chaturthi prevailing at Madhyahna (midday); the spec's rule set has no madhyahna rule, so sunrise is used; review.
